versions.changelog:
Initial release of the TikTok API alternative for fetcher.sh.

- Provides 13 GET endpoints for TikTok data, including keyword search, profile and post lookup, hashtags, sounds, locations, and comment threads.
- Flexible pay-per-call pricing ($0.004/call) via x402 (USDC) or prepaid Bearer keys; no TikTok login or app review required.
- Supports use cases such as trend tracking, hashtag monitoring, competitor analysis, influencer discovery, and TikTok data pipelines without browser automation.
- Includes example curl commands, detailed endpoint explanations, error handling guidance, and links to additional documentation.
